title: fix(app-shell): three console dates read the display locale, not the UI language (objectui#10331)
body:
Fixes #10331
Clause-②: no

Three console date faces now take their locale from `useDisplayLocale()` instead of the UI language. Implemented by `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC` (seat `domain:ui#1`, a dispatched dev subagent), on base `0651e7ab4`.

## Premise, re-derived on `0651e7ab4`

All three call sites were on `origin/main` exactly as the card and the triage grading (`5820846444`) quote them:

- `InstalledListWidget.tsx`: `new Date(entry.installedAt).toLocaleString(language || undefined)`
- `MarketplacePage.tsx` (inside `useRelativeFormatter`): `new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat(language || 'en', { numeric: 'auto' })`
- `CloudConnectionPanel.tsx`: `new Date(conn.bound_at).toLocaleString(language)`

The contract, from `packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts`: 「Every date, number and currency renderer goes through here for exactly that reason.」

## What changed

- `InstalledList` (`InstalledListWidget.tsx`) and `CloudConnectionPanel` call `useDisplayLocale()` at the top of the component, next to `useObjectTranslation()`, and format the date with it. `language` had no other use in either file, so it is no longer destructured there.
- `MarketplacePage.tsx`: the formatter lives in `useRelativeFormatter`. That is a custom hook called from the component body, not a plain helper, so it calls `useDisplayLocale()` itself and no locale parameter had to be threaded. `language` stays in `MarketplacePage` for `localizePackage(pkg, language)`: that picks the package's translated name and description, which is a translation choice, not a formatting locale.
- No site falls back to `undefined` (the machine locale) or to a literal `'en'` any more. The hook owns the last-resort tag.
- `packages/i18n/**` is not touched except one test pin this change broke (see the seat edit below), and no other console face is touched.
- Changeset: `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`. It states the behaviour change: dates on these three faces now follow the display locale.

## Tests

New pins, one `describe` per face. Every case mounts the real `I18nProvider` with an English UI (`defaultLanguage: 'en'`) and declares the display locale through `LocalizationProvider`, so the display locale is the only thing that varies:

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/marketplaceDates.displayLocale-10331.test.tsx`: `InstalledList` and `MarketplacePage`
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/cloud-connection/__tests__/CloudConnectionPanel.displayLocale-10331.test.tsx`: `CloudConnectionPanel`

Each face has four cases:

- the `de-CH` pin: a literal `4.3.2020` or `vor 3 Tagen`, plus equality with the runtime's own `de-CH` rendering;
- the `en-US` control: `3/4/2020` or `3 days ago`;
- a differential: the `de-CH` rendering differs from the `en-US` one, which no runner locale can satisfy;
- the `@object-ui/test-support` tripwire: every call of the face's formatter received `de-CH`, and no call got the machine locale.

The relative-time fixture is three days old. That gives "vor 3 Tagen" against "3 days ago", and it never reaches the translated "today" bucket.

Runs from the repo root at `4c08ed0a6`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/ packages/app-shell/src/console/cloud-connection/ packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/HomePage.marketplaceDisabled.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.pseudoRouteSegments.test.tsx packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts` gives `Test Files 18 passed (18)` and `Tests 134 passed (134)`. That covers the 12 new pins, every marketplace and cloud-connection neighbour, the two other suites that mount these components, and the objectui#9909 census, which scans these files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0, after building the app-shell dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/app-shell^..."`, 28 of 28 tasks). `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists both new pin files.

## Ablation: fix committed first, every leg restored with on-disk proof

Each leg puts the pre-fix UI-language value back at ONE face through `ablation-replace.mjs`, then runs both pin files. The anchor is `const displayLocale = useDisplayLocale();`, and it must hit exactly once.

| leg | replacement | red | green |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| InstalledList | `useObjectTranslation().language \|\| undefined` | that face's de-CH pin, differential and tripwire (3) | its en-US control and both other faces (9) |
| MarketplacePage | `useObjectTranslation().language \|\| 'en'` | same three for that face (3) | 9 |
| CloudConnectionPanel | `useObjectTranslation().language` | same three for that face (3) | 9 |

The red readings:

- InstalledList: `expected 'Installed 3/4/2020, 12:00:00 PM' to match /4\.3\.2020/`
- MarketplacePage: `expected '3 days ago' to be 'vor 3 Tagen'`
- CloudConnectionPanel: `expected '3/4/2020, 12:00:00 PM' to match /4\.3\.2020/`

The `en-US` control stays green on every leg. It cannot tell `en` from `en-US`, which is why it is the control and not a pin.

On-disk proof for each leg:

- The anchor count went 1 to 0, the replacement count 0 to 1, and the blob changed (InstalledList `d2eaeb1d83d6` to `2747907f61b3`).
- After the restore, each blob equals HEAD's (`d2eaeb1d83d6`, `d01379567cfd`, `a3083f630e87`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `git status --porcelain` was empty at the end.

No `dist/` is on the path: the pins import the components by relative path, and vitest aliases `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/test-support` to `src`.

## Gates

`dispatch-gates.mjs` only works in objectstack, so these were derived by hand from this repo's `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`:

- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 5 source files of 1 released package changed, and 1 changeset is declared.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`: the self-contradiction reading is clean. The went-false reading flags `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md`, which names `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx`. I read it: the paragraph is about how the chunks are split around the barrel's SDUI-registration import. This change adds one named import from a package the file already imports, so the paragraph still holds.
- Derived for the new test files and the changeset: `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-vi-mock-inherit`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-overwrite`. All OK.
- Lint: the full `pnpm lint` is left to CI. ESLint was run on the 5 changed files from `packages/app-shell`, whose own `lint` script is `eslint .`.
  - Result: 5 files, 0 errors, and no warnings on the two pins. The three sources carry 2, 3 and 6 warnings (pre-existing `no-explicit-any` and `set-state-in-effect`), the same counts as their base blobs.
  - `eslint --print-config` resolves all 5 files, so none of them is ignored.
  - `eslint.config.js` configures no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and the local rules read no other files. So this diff cannot change the lint result of a file it does not touch.

## Why the objectui#9909 census missed these, and a cheap extension

`machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts` sorts the first argument into bare, `undefined`, `'default'`, a BCP-47 literal, or an expression. It deliberately skips expressions; its header says "A call that passes an EXPRESSION is not judged here". All three sites passed an expression.

- **Cheap to add:** an expression whose top-level fallback ends in `|| undefined`, `?? undefined` or `|| 'tag'` is the machine locale or a literal in disguise. The census could classify it as the `undefined` or `literal` shape. A single-line `git grep` for that shape over `packages` and `apps` (tests excluded) at `0651e7ab4` finds exactly two sites: this card's `InstalledListWidget` and `MarketplacePage`. After this PR, that extension would land green with no new exemption. The grep is an approximation: the census reads a 60-character window across lines, and the grep only reads single lines.
- **Not cheap:** a bare `language` argument (the UI-language channel) cannot be told apart from a correctly named variable without data flow. The same grep with `language` or `i18n.language` as the first argument finds three sites at `0651e7ab4`: this card's `CloudConnectionPanel` and the two faces below. That rule would land red.

Neither extension is built here, as the card asks.

## Seat edit (2026-09-24T20:59Z): a pin this change broke, fixed at `55f546173`

CI at `4c08ed0a6` was red on one test outside the claim's surface. `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/marketplace-preview-namespace-3546.test.tsx` (「all five owning components bind t from a bare useObjectTranslation」) matched the literal `import { useObjectTranslation } from '@object-ui/i18n'`, and `MarketplacePage.tsx` now imports `{ useDisplayLocale, useObjectTranslation }`. The respin fixes the pin, not the import. The check is now a regex that accepts a named-import list from `@object-ui/i18n` holding the bare, un-renamed `useObjectTranslation`. A new control test accepts single-name, two-name and multi-line lists, and rejects a missing name, `useObjectTranslationSafe`, an `as` rename, `import type`, `@object-ui/i18n-extra` and `./i18n`. Mutating the import to `{ useDisplayLocale }` reddens exactly this pin. The seat widened the claim's surface to this one test file.

At `55f546173`: `vitest run packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/console/` gives 157 files and 1748 tests passed. The 8 other test files naming these sources give 539 passed. The `app-shell` and `i18n` type-checks exit 0, and `check:i18n-keys` passes.

## Acceptance notes

- Two more date faces format with the UI language instead of the display locale. They are outside this card's fence, so they are reported to the seat and not changed here:
  - `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`: `formatRelative`'s bucket for items older than 30 days, `toLocaleDateString(language)`.
  - `packages/collaboration/src/CommentThread.tsx`: `formatAbsoluteDate(date, language)`, for comments older than 7 days. Its doc comment chose "the session language" under objectui#3441.
- No README or `content/docs` change. For the app-shell half this follows the objectui#10232 precedent; the changeset carries the user-facing sentence.
